title: Add CI: tests, plugin validate, lore check and Tracker integrity
description: DEC-168 (7): profile-skills stays unlisted (operator kept the hold under DEC-168 (4)) but gets CI. profile-skills has no .github/ at all. Add .github/workflows/ci.yml in diagram-skills' shape with four jobs: tests (the engine suite in tests/, pytest on Python 3.9 and 3.12), plugin validate (claude plugin validate .), lore check (docs bundle present, generated by lore/0.12.0), and Tracker integrity (.quest present; quest version read from CLAUDE.md, 0.12.0). Prove the gate both ways on throwaway branches never merged: a deliberate violation reddens its own job and the clean tree is green. Then DRAFT a required-checks ruleset for refs/heads/dev and send it to the orchestrator; the operator applies it first-party, so it is NOT applied here. Do not touch evals/ (an eval-viewer process is running there).

acceptanceCriteria.text: A .github/workflows/ci.yml exists with jobs tests (pytest on 3.9 and 3.12), plugin validate (claude plugin validate .), lore check and Tracker integrity
The CI lands through a PR into dev with all jobs green on the head

Both directions are proven on throwaway branches that are deleted and never merged: a deliberate violation reddens its own job with the log read for the exit code and message while every other job stays green, and a clean tree is green
A draft required-checks ruleset for refs/heads/dev is prepared and sent to the orchestrator and is NOT applied
